payg.title: Charge by traffic
payg.automatic: Connect freely. Pay as you go.
payg.comboIntro: One plan. More room to explore.
payg.loadFailed: Pay-as-you-go details could not be loaded.
payg.adminHint: Charge by traffic is automatic for all eligible members. Active and paid queued fixed-term plans keep their squads until expiry; future renewals exclude them.

traffic.connectDetail: Example starting balance: 10 TXB. Eligible squads are available automatically while traffic billing is enabled and the account is funded. Connecting alone does not buy a block.
traffic.firstBlockDetail: When this node reaches 100 MiB of traffic in the rolling 72-hour window, a 1 GiB block is purchased. At this example rate of 1 TXB per GiB, the wallet becomes 9 TXB and 924 MiB remains after covering that usage.
traffic.useCreditDetail: Traffic uses the prepaid block. At 512 MiB used, 512 MiB remains and the wallet stays at 9 TXB. The wallet is charged by blocks, not continuously by byte.
traffic.nextBlockDetail: After the first block is exhausted, additional reported traffic buys the next 1 GiB block at its applicable price. This example has used 1.5 GiB, spent 2 TXB and retained 512 MiB.
traffic.reconnectDetail: Reconnecting to the same node keeps its unexpired prepaid credit. The example wallet stays at 8 TXB with 512 MiB left; a reconnect does not start a new charge.
traffic.expireDetail: Unused prepaid traffic expires 72 hours after the latest block purchase. Expiry alone does not buy another block. With no new traffic, this example wallet stays at 8 TXB.

hourly.enableDetail: One illustrative squad costs 1 TXB per hour and the wallet starts at 10 TXB. Activation at 12:30 UTC pays 0.50 TXB for the remaining half-hour. The required activation balance is an eligibility check, not an upfront charge or reservation.
hourly.renewDetail: The next whole UTC hour costs 1 TXB in this example and may be funded shortly before its boundary to keep access continuous. Enabled squads renew independently, including while idle. If the next hour cannot be funded, access stops at its paid boundary.
hourly.poolDetail: Hourly squads share the account-wide daily full-speed allowance. Traffic within that allowance does not add a traffic charge; each enabled squad still has its own hourly charge.
hourly.extraDetail: With automatic extra purchases explicitly enabled, continuing traffic can purchase a 1 decimal GB block at the approved price. This example deducts 0.20 TXB and restores full-speed credit. If a block cannot be funded, reduced speed applies.
hourly.disableDetail: Voluntary disable stops this squad immediately. The already-paid hour is not refunded and the configured cooldown must pass before enabling it again. Unused purchased traffic remains available to other hourly squads until midnight UTC.
hourly.midnightDetail: At midnight UTC, the daily allowance resets and unused purchased extra traffic expires. This does not re-enable a disabled squad or refund expired credit.
hourly.throttleDetail: After the shared free allowance and any purchased full-speed credit are exhausted, the configured reduced speed applies. Hourly access charges continue while the squad remains enabled.
